Primary Source: Real-Time Population Survey via FRED; Bick, Blandin, and Deming
Interpretation Boundary: Measures reported overall, personal, work, prior-week, and daily use. Does not measure paid conversion, provider share, consumer revenue, or realized value.

Primary Source: BLS Consumer Price Index via retained FRED history
Frequency / Coverage: Monthly, aligned to each earnings observation
Interpretation Boundary: Deflates nominal hourly earnings to the purchasing power of the latest CPI observation not later than the latest retained earnings month; does not attribute wage changes to AI.
